anti_overlap: Focus on prompt engineering and output format, not integration plumbing (fd-openrouter-dispatch-integration) or cost routing (fd-heterogeneous-fleet-cost-routing)
decision_lens: Does the current prompt template produce structurally identical outputs on non-Claude models, or does it silently degrade?
focus: Whether interflux's Claude-optimized agent prompts work on DeepSeek/Qwen without silent quality degradation
name: fd-prompt-portability-across-families
persona: A prompt engineer who has shipped production systems across multiple model families and knows exactly where prompts break silently
review_areas: Findings Index format compliance: do DeepSeek/Qwen reliably produce the exact '- SEVERITY | ID | Section | Title' format?
Instruction following fidelity: which prompt sections (output format, peer findings protocol, focus area) degrade on non-Claude models?
Refusal and safety differences: do Chinese models refuse different content patterns than Claude (geopolitical, IP sensitivity)?
System prompt vs user prompt split: some models handle system prompts differently — does the agent prompt template need restructuring?
XML tag handling: interflux uses XML-style tags in prompts — do non-Claude models parse these the same way?

severity_examples.condition: When the model ignores structured output instructions and produces free-form prose
severity_examples.scenario: DeepSeek produces findings without Findings Index header, breaking synthesis parsing entirely

severity_examples.condition: When the model doesn't follow 'start with ### Findings Index' instruction literally
severity_examples.scenario: Qwen adds extra reasoning before the findings, causing the Findings Index regex to fail on the first non-empty line check

severity_examples.condition: When the model treats persona as flavor text instead of behavioral constraint
severity_examples.scenario: Agent persona instructions are interpreted differently, producing generic instead of domain-specific analysis

success_hints: Look for prompt template variants per model family, output format validation before synthesis, and empirical testing results across models
task_context: The current prompt template (references/prompt-template.md) was designed for Claude. No testing on other model families has been done.
